summary: Final VeriScan regression: core Expo flow passed through onboarding, home, manual seeded scan, Vitamin E sheet open/close, plans INR pricing, and unknown-barcode contribution screen. Backend health, guest entitlement, sorted ingredients, history, plans, unknown barcode, registration/login, and guest-history migration all passed.
action_items: No application fixes required from this regression. For future automation, assert the unknown barcode using a substring/regex because barcode and surrounding copy render in one Text node.
critical_code_review_comments: No critical code-review blockers found in the referenced files.
Payment paths correctly return graceful 503 configuration errors when Stripe secrets are absent; no real payment was attempted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executed UI assertions; unknown flow reached contribution screen, but one exact-text assertion was invalid

seed_data_creation: Created only transient UUID guest/history test data and used the existing migration-check@example.com account; no application seed data changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: External preview tested at 390x844. Credentials read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No application files edited.
rca_of_issue: The first UI script reached the unknown-barcode contribution screen, then failed because get_by_text('9999999999999', exact=True) cannot match text nested in the single rendered sentence 'Barcode 9999999999999 is not in our registry yet...'. A follow-up attempt started in a fresh browser context and stopped at onboarding, so guest-history/auth migration was validated through the public API regression instead.
